test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the incorrect statement from the following:

i. When Mendeleev started his work on the periodic table, 63 elements were known.

ii. Mendeleev focused on compounds formed by elements containing oxygen and hydrogen.

iii. Mendeleev investigated the relationship between the atomic numbers of elements.

iv. Mendeleev investigated the relationship between the physical and chemical properties of elements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**iii. Mendeleev investigated the relationship between the atomic numbers of elements.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mendeleev arranged elements in the periodic table based on their atomic masses and properties, not their atomic numbers.
 
• Mendeleev’s periodic table was created before the discovery of protons and neutrons, which led to the concept of atomic numbers.
 
• The modern periodic table is based on atomic numbers, which was introduced by Henry Moseley after Mendeleev's work.
 
• Mendeleev left gaps in his periodic table for undiscovered elements and predicted their properties based on periodic trends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodic Table:**

 
 
• A tabular arrangement of elements ordered by their atomic number, electron configurations, and recurring chemical properties.
 
• The modern periodic table has 118 confirmed elements, arranged in 7 periods and 18 groups.
 
 
 
• **Atomic Number:**
 
 
• The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom, which determines the element’s identity and its position in the periodic table.
 
• Atomic number increases sequentially from hydrogen (1) to oganesson (118).
 
 
 
• **Mendeleev’s Contributions:**
 
 
• Dmitri Mendeleev is credited with creating one of the first versions of the periodic table in 1869.
 
• He arranged the 63 known elements by increasing atomic mass and grouped them by similar chemical properties.
 
• Mendeleev predicted the existence and properties of elements that were not yet discovered, such as gallium and germanium.
 
 
 
• **Henry Moseley’s Work:**
 
 
• Henry Moseley, an English physicist, refined the periodic table by arranging elements according to their atomic numbers instead of atomic masses.
 
• Moseley's work established the modern periodic law, which states that the properties of elements are a periodic function of their atomic numbers.
